feeds.title: Organise My House Blog
feeds.description: A UK based blog that aims to simplify life, one step at a time. Organise My House is packed with inspiration/ideas and tips on all aspects of homemaking and living a simpler life. Get your home and life organized with simple tips and inspiration from Organise My House

feeds.title: Homemaking & Horticulture
feeds.description: Our homes are our castles, and creating a space where we are happy and comfortable is so important. Homemaking and Horticulture features tips and advice about homes, gardens, entertaining, family life and much more. My name is Stacey, I'm a passionate blogger from the West Midlands in the UK and love everything home related.

feeds.title: A Tidy Mind Blog
feeds.description: This blog was founded by Kristin in 2016, who is a certified coach for decluttering, organizing, and minimalism. A Tidy Mind's mission is to help individuals achieve a more organized and peaceful life through decluttering their physical space and embracing minimalism.

feeds.title: Mum, Thats Me
feeds.description: This blog was founded by a UK-based mom in 2012. Its mission is to offer a friendly, relatable space for moms to find parenting advice, product reviews, and lifestyle tips. Mum, That's Me also features family-friendly recipes and travel content.

feeds.title: Roseyhome
feeds.description: This UK-based blog was founded by Sarah in 2013. Its mission is to offer inspiration and advice on homemaking, parenting, and lifestyle topics. Roseyhome features content on cooking, home decor, travel, and beauty. The blog also offers product reviews and giveaways.

feeds.title: Housekeeper London Blog
feeds.description: This is the website of a small team of private house and apartment cleaners. We offer both regular and one-off cleaning, while pricing depends on the property and volume of work. Housekeeper London blog is a must read source of information about cleaning tips and cleaning tasks that every homekeeper should definitely check out.
